column7: A live PostgreSQL admin backup under key_dir_lock: database held the shared server-presence lock but never looked at Presence.Lost: with the lock lost mid-backup (backend terminated, failover) a key rotation could run in the window and the archive was still finished and reported OK. It now stops writing, cancels the snapshot reads, removes the partial output and fails (POOLER-LOCKLOSS-1 follow-up).
